description: Nigerian Multi-modal Road Traffic Crash Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Patricia Ojonoka Idakwo (African University of Science and Technology Abuja (AUST)). This is a Nigerian multi-modal road traffic crash (RTC) dataset curated from the Nigerian RTC corpus collected by Idakwo et al. (2025). Coverage: national (NG); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
